items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: just myself and King Johnson, played -- wherever the one was, the other one was there... So we went to Jesse Stone with the same brass section.

ctx.x: Yeah. Were any of your brothers in that band?
No, just myself and King Johnson, played -- wherever the one was, the other one was there, and then them three trumpets. So we went to Jesse Stone with the same brass section.
